days.title: Your first shot
days.description: Take 10 photos of things around your home. Focus on finding interesting angles.
days.tip: Don't worry about quality — just shoot freely

days.title: Understanding light
days.description: Take the same photo at 3 different times of day. Compare the results.
days.tip: Golden hour gives the best natural light

days.title: The rule of thirds
days.description: Enable the grid on your camera. Take 5 photos placing your subject on a grid line.
days.tip: Subjects on grid intersections look more balanced than centred subjects

days.title: Shoot in manual mode
days.description: Switch to manual mode. Experiment with ISO, aperture, and shutter speed.
days.tip: Start with ISO 100, f/8, 1/125s as a baseline

days.title: Your first edit
days.description: Pick your best photo from this week. Edit it using Lightroom Mobile (free).
days.tip: Adjust exposure first, then contrast, then colour temperature

days.title: Street photography
days.description: Go outside and take 20 candid shots of your neighbourhood.
days.tip: Use burst mode to capture movement

days.title: Week 1 review
days.description: Pick your 3 favourite shots from this week. Write one sentence about what you like about each.
days.tip: Reflection is how you train your eye faster
